original_poem:
यह न थी हमारी किस्मत,  
के विसाल-ए-यार हो।  
अगर और जीते रहते,  
यही इंतज़ार होता।  

किसे अपनी आरज़ू से,  
खुश करना था हमको।  
सभी को नज़र से छिपा,  
बस तेरा ही नाम था।
translated_poem:
This was not our fate,  
To meet the beloved.  
If we had lived longer,  
This would have been the wait.  

Who did we have to please  
With our desires?  
Hidden from everyone,  
Only your name was there.
